About Safari Hotel

Safari Hotel Upper Mall is a 2–3 star hotel at 100-C Anand Road, Upper Mall, Lahore — a quiet, tree-lined part of the city, reached through the hotel's own green entrance gate.

Guests are looked after around the clock: the front desk is open 24 hours, rooms come with free WiFi and room service, and cars can be left in the hotel's on-site parking.

On Google, the hotel is rated 4.1 stars from 411 reviews.

Amenities

Everything a guest needs for a simple, comfortable stay — photographed at the hotel itself.

24-Hour Front Desk

The reception at Safari Hotel is staffed day and night, so help is available whenever you arrive or whenever you need anything during your stay.

Comfortable Rooms

Clean, furnished guest rooms with proper bedding, bedside lamps and seating — a restful base in the middle of Lahore.

Free WiFi

Stay connected throughout your stay with free WiFi — for work, messages and planning your time in Lahore.

Room Service

Prefer to stay in? Room service brings what you need to your room — just ask the front desk.

On-Site Parking

Drive in through the main gate and park inside the hotel premises — no hunting for a spot on the street.

For room availability, call the hotel on +92 336 4000649 or send a WhatsApp message using the buttons on this page.
